  tirhisiweke

Tibendi ta rimba i swikombo swo kunguhata loko swimila swi mile swi tiya; a swi katsiwi eka tinhlayo ta
swakudya kumbe mintirho yo tshovela. Tin’hweti leti nga riki na swilo a ti na nkarhi wo tshovela lowu
funghiweke. Vukhale bya swimila lowu rhekhodiweke byi sivela swimila leswitsongo ku katsiwa eka tin’hweti
ta le ku sunguleni ta swikombo. Kambela vukhale bya swimila ni Swihlovo swa swakudya leswi faneleke ku
kamberiwa eka app. Mintila ya nsuku yi lava swiyimo swa vuhlayiselo swa xibyariwa xin’wana ni xin’wana;
kambela pulani leyi heleleke kumbe app. Tinhlayo to tshwuka ta ndhawu ti vula leswaku pulani yi lava
ndhawu yo byala yo tala ku hundza leyi nga eka mepe.

  Fhethu ha u lima ho
  shumiswaho

Mabande a luhura ndi zwiko zwa u pulana musi zwimela zwo no khwaṱha; a zwi katelwi kha tshivhalo tsha
zwiḽiwa kana mishumo ya u kaṋa. Miṅwedzi i si na tshithu a i na tshifhinga tsha u kaṋa tsho swaiwaho.
Miṅwaha ya zwimela yo rekhodiwaho i thivhela zwimela zwiṱuku u katelwa kha miṅwedzi ya u thoma ya
zwiko. Sedzulusani miṅwaha ya zwimela na Zwiko zwa zwiḽiwa zwine zwa fanela u sedzuluswa kha app. Mitalo
ya musuku i ṱoḓa nyimele dza u vhulunga dza tshiliṅwa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe; sedzulusani pulane yo fhelelaho
kana app. Mbalo tswuku dza fhethu dzi amba uri pulane i ṱoḓa fhethu ha u lima hunzhi u fhira hu re kha
mapa.
